newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares seen range-bound, blue chips weak.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares seen range-bound, blue chips weak.

text.p: Singapore shares were seen mostly range-bound on Friday except for blue chips, which were likely to remain weak on thin fund interest, dealers said.
Bearish technical charts were also likely to keep optimism at bay.
The benchmark Straits Times Industrials Index slumped 34.06 points on programme selling on Thursday to end at 1,989.80
Wall Street's Dow Jones Industrial Index eased 35.74 points on Thursday to 7,654.24.
